responsibility: Route selected rows to same-engine Spark or future manifest-declared Spark cross-dialect roles; preserve common EngineExecutionResult contract.
inputs: SelectedCaseEngineRow; resolved package metadata; candidate SQL path; workspace path; timeout; schema prefix
outputs: EngineExecutionResult from spark_execution.py or unsupported role result
must_not_own: Spark session startup; Spark SQL execution; schema DDL/load execution details; checker logic; timing metrics; official metrics
fail_closed_behavior: If selected role is unsupported or target engine mismatches metadata, return unsupported/cross-dialect fail-closed result without fallback.
notes: Router should sequence source-reference and target-candidate execution for future cross-dialect Spark only from manifest roles.

responsibility: Own Spark local diagnostic execution: environment check; schema asset resolution; session/database namespace; DDL/load execution; source/candidate SQL execution; JSONL export; metadata/error artifacts; cleanup.
inputs: repo root; run id; selected row; resolved package; candidate SQL path; workspace; timeout; schema prefix; Spark env
outputs: EngineExecutionResult; source_result.jsonl; candidate_result.jsonl; source/candidate errors; spark_execution_metadata.json
must_not_own: Adapter invocation; candidate preflight; checker comparison; quality summary; tag slices; official metrics; timing/speedup interpretation; reports/results writes
fail_closed_behavior: Return explicit Spark status such as spark_not_configured, spark_client_missing, spark_schema_missing, spark_source_execution_failed, or spark_candidate_execution_failed.
notes: Should never fall back to PostgreSQL/MySQL schema assets or execute another engine.

responsibility: Expose manifest-declared local diagnostic roles and case schema profile/external profile paths already needed by Spark.
outputs: ResolvedCasePackage with diagnostic_mode and role metadata
must_not_own: Spark-specific schema parsing or session behavior
fail_closed_behavior: Missing selected-engine PORT role remains unsupported; non-PORT remains same-engine by default.
notes: No role inference from filenames or SQL text.

responsibility: Declare Spark DDL/load asset paths under engines.spark.
fail_closed_behavior: Missing or non-existent Spark asset maps to spark_schema_missing.
notes: PostgreSQL/MySQL assets must not be substituted for Spark.

responsibility: Consume Spark source/candidate JSONL artifacts through the existing checker interface.
must_not_own: Spark execution; Spark type conversion; Spark schema setup; official semantic verification
notes: No new broad Spark normalization is authorized by this design.

responsibility: Record and summarize Spark execution statuses from EngineExecutionResult using existing local diagnostic fields.
inputs: Ledger rows with source/candidate/checker statuses and failure buckets
must_not_own: Spark execution or checker logic; official metrics; leaderboard scoring
fail_closed_behavior: Spark failures map to existing failure buckets and remain denominator-aware local diagnostics.
notes: No new timing or metric fields should be introduced.
